d:
Halwai jaisi gobhi aloo ki sabzi ghar par - bina deep fry, bina pyaaz-lehsun! Saath mein gobhi ka paratha
Masala Kitchen mein Poonam Devnani sikhati hain shaadi wali gobhi aloo ka swad, sarson ke tel mein, kam tel se. Saath mein gobhi ka bhara paratha jiski stuffing paani nahi chhodti.
Halwai jaisi gobhi aloo - bina deep fry, bina pyaaz-lehsun
Gobhi ka bhara paratha - paani nichod kar, bina namak ki stuffing
Sarson ke tel ka tikhapan kam karne ka ghar wala tarika
Soft aate se bina maide ke crisp paratha
